summary: Post-market recap: the composite risk score closed at 41.82, down 0.65 on the day, still inside the caution band and a goldilocks regime. The session's main thread was a broad rally in rates — the 10-year Treasury yield eased from 4.7 to 4.63, the 2-year from 4.25 to 4.2, and the 10-year real rate from 2.43 to 2.4, while VIX slipped from 16.5 to 15.81, jointly relieving marginal pressure on the volatility and macro dimensions. Macro nonetheless remains the highest-scoring dimension at 75.26, because the real and nominal rate percentiles are still 98.25 and 96.43 — the absolute levels have not left restrictive territory. Equity structure shows a clear divergence: 87.5% of constituents sit above their 200-day average, yet the new-highs ratio is 0.0, and semis relative strength of 0.8672 against small-cap relative of -0.6685 marks a two-pole tape, with single names such as AppLovin -17% and UWM -40% breaking beneath a calm index. Credit remains the strongest support, with high-yield spreads at 2.75 and investment-grade at 0.78, in the 15.37 and 17.3 percentiles.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.6667 is the single largest risk contributor (contribution 7.5), and it is a proxy indicator discounted by 0.64.

Macro leads all dimensions at 75.26: the 10-year real rate of 2.4 sits in the 98.25 percentile and the 10-year nominal yield of 4.63 in the 96.43 percentile, and today's decline does not change how elevated those absolute levels remain.
The new-highs ratio is 0.0, diverging from the 0.875 share of constituents above the 200-day average; this contributes 3.13 and shows the index advancing without new-high confirmation.
Leadership is narrow: semis relative strength 0.8672 versus small-cap relative -0.6685, leaving the equity-structure dimension at 38.48.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit is near its easiest historically: high-yield spreads at 2.75 in the 15.37 percentile and investment-grade at 0.78 in the 17.3 percentile, holding the liquidity-and-credit dimension at just 16.01.
VIX closed at 15.81, in the 28.57 percentile, with the volatility dimension trending lower.
Trend structure is intact: price is 9.4437% above the 200-day average, 3-month momentum is 4.7654 and the 52-week drawdown is only -0.328.
Semiconductor leaders closed higher: AMD +2.0869%, AVGO +0.8917%, NVDA +0.276%, offsetting the drag from the memory complex.

contradicting_signals.claim: The memory chain stays the weak link: MU closed at -0.0896%, merely clawing back its intraday loss, and that story carries the day's highest importance score of 64.96.
Crypto softened in tandem: BTC at 64416.0, ETH at 1908.25 and SOL at 72.68, so risk appetite is not broadening across the board.
Single-name breaks appeared: TSLA closed -0.905%, AppLovin plunged 17% on a Q2 revenue miss, and UWM collapsed 40% after suspending its dividend and raising capital.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score closed at 41.82, down 0.65 intraday, keeping the risk level at caution and the regime at goldilocks.
Rates fell across the curve: 10-year 4.7 → 4.63, 2-year 4.25 → 4.2, 10-year real rate 2.43 → 2.4, breakeven inflation 2.23 → 2.22.
VIX fell from 16.5 to 15.81, the direct driver of the softer volatility dimension.
Credit showed a very slight divergence: high-yield spreads widened from 2.73 to 2.75 while investment grade held flat at 0.78.
Dispersion inside semis narrowed: AMD +2.0869%, AVGO +0.8917% and NVDA +0.276% closed higher while MU at -0.0896% finished roughly flat, and the memory selloff did not spread.
Single-stock risk events clustered: AppLovin -17% and UWM -40%, in contrast with calm at the index level.
watch_next: Friday's payrolls report: consensus is a gain of 83,000 with the unemployment rate unchanged at 4.2% — tomorrow's biggest macro variable.
Whether the 10-year holds below 4.63 and the real rate stays under 2.4 will decide if the 75.26 macro dimension eases.
Whether the new-highs ratio lifts off 0.0 is the key test of the quality behind 0.875 breadth.
Follow-through in memory: whether MU can turn positive after finishing at -0.0896% will decide if the 0.8672 semis relative strength persists.
Whether credit keeps widening: if high-yield spreads at 2.75 keep rising, they will erode the current 16.01 advantage in the liquidity-and-credit dimension.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the rate rally extends and breadth converts into new highs
points: If the 10-year keeps falling from 4.63 and the real rate breaks below 2.4, the 75.26 macro dimension becomes the largest source of score downgrade.
The 0.875 share above the moving average combined with a new-highs ratio recovering from 0.0 could push the 38.48 equity-structure score lower.
Credit holding spreads as low as 2.75 and 0.78 keeps providing valuation support.

base_case.title: Base case: choppy caution around 41.82
points: Macro at 75.26 and credit at 16.01 offset each other, keeping the composite inside the caution band.
Cross-asset confirmation stalls at 0.6667, and the proxy discount keeps it contributing 7.5 of risk score.
Confidence of 0.7683 and consistency of 0.6314 make the read moderately robust and argue for waiting on more confirmation.

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates back up while credit widens
points: If payrolls beat and push the 10-year back above 4.7, the 98.25 percentile on the 2.4 real rate would dominate pricing again.
High-yield spreads widening further from 2.75 would lift both the 16.01 credit dimension and the overall risk score.
A new-highs ratio stuck at 0.0 with small-cap relative strength at -0.6685 means narrow leadership could end in catch-down selling.
